title: We loved it!
text: Christian was fantastic! So knowledgeable and friendly. We loved the walking tour and 1 hour mosaic workshop was very fun.
author: Brad_M

title: Fantastic guides and services!
text: Barcelona Feeing is attentive to detail and willing to customize for group needs! We had a large group of university students for walking tour  and they were fantastic with the students connecting with them and ensuring all went smooth for a group of 30 +. We will definitely use again.
author: 502jalyssab

title: A nice experience
text: A very nice experience. Just the right amount of time, walking and information. Christian was very nice and infoermative.
author: freddy483

title: Great afternoon
text:
We would recommend this fabulous and interesting tour. 

We went with children aged 9-11. We all found Christian was engaging and knowledgable, with lots of good anecdotes. Because of the small group, there was plenty of time to ask questions. 

We all enjoyed the mosaic workshop - time for a little mosaic on a fridge magnet or box.
author: Kitty_S

title: Great tour, also with kids
text: Since we did an online tour of Barcelona with the whole family during Corona times, it was finally time for us to travel again. Of course we wanted to do a live tour with Christian. Since I was traveling with my 9-year-old son, we decided to go on this architectural tour with a mosaic workshop. We weren't disappointed. Christian has matched the content wonderfully to the age of my son, so he was not bored during the two-hour walk. author: Y6582KPandrea

title: A must see-and-do!
text:
A wonderful experience in a very relaxed atmosphere. I had the pleasure to have a one-on-one walk-and-talk and it took me to wonderful places and great conversations that went beyond the realm of architecture!
The ceramic workshop was a lot of fun and it feels very rewarding to go home with a little piece of "art". I will do it again for sure next time I'm in town! Can't wait!
author: LaurenceV1313

title: Creating memories
text: This tour is a great combination-- 1st you get a chance to make a real mosaic - and appreciate the genius that went into all the designs around Barcelona.  Our children loved the opportunity to create a small piece of the beauty that is Barcelona  The highlight though was the Gaudi/Building tour with Christian!  His insight and knowledge was unbelievable - he truly brought the city alive.  Our children 18, 15 and 13 enjoyed his stories and really wanted to learn more.  Great way to dive into the architecture of Barcelona.
author: Y9994ZLchristianc

title: Great Way to Spend an Afternoon!
text: What a wonderful afternoon! Our family (teens and their parents) so enjoyed our private tour of Barcelona with Christian! He is incredibly knowledgeable about Gaudí and “modernism” architecture. We traipsed around the city, stopping to look at fabulous architecture and hearing great stories along the way. Christian is a wonderful guide, had lots to share and made the two hours fly by. After our leisurely, two hour promenade, Christian handed us off to Angelika and we made lovely mosaics in her studio in an hour! author: carrollcas

title: Amazing way to experience Barcelona and take home a truly meaningful souvenir!
text: We are a family of 4 (10 and 14 yr olds) who wanted a unique experience in Barcelona, so we booked the Gaudí Tour & Mosaic Workshop and it was AMAZING! Christian started us off with a walking tour of some of Gaudí's (Casa Mila, Casa Batllo) and works by other architects of his time. He gave us a great overview of Gaudí--answering every one of our questions--and made the walking tour interesting to all 4 of us (not an easy feat, as it was booked on our second day there and we were jet lagged). Then he dropped us off at Angelika's studio where we could have stayed for hours working on our mosaic
